name: Seek and Destroy
primaryObjective: Score 1 VP for each controlled objective during every scoring Round.

tacticalObjective.name: Eliminate Opposition
tacticalObjective.effect: Gain 1 Tactical VP if at least one enemy Unit was defeated during the current Round. A multi-model Unit counts as defeated when its last Model is removed or defeated. A Player Character or other single-model Character counts as defeated for this condition when it becomes Downed.

specialRules: Defeating additional Units during the same Round does not award additional Tactical VP.
Units escaping the battlefield or returning to Reserves are not considered defeated.
designNotes: Seek and Destroy encourages active combat while preserving the importance of controlling objectives. It is especially suitable for armies designed around decisive engagements and aggressive assaults.
